Problem Statement:
Write a Java program that accepts two integer values as input and prints the minimum of those two values using if-else statements. 
Input Description:
The program should accept two integers as input. 
Output Description:
The program should output the minimum value among the two integers. 
Sample Input:
10 20 
Sample Output:
10
